library(tidycensus)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)


census_api_key("db7c5219cbb7eb25653b03718b0cc4cacedb5069", install = TRUE)

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# VARIABLE LISTS
# -------------------------------------------------------------

# ===============================
# AGE (B01001) — 18+
# ===============================
age_vars <- c(
  "B01001_007",  # Male 18–19
  "B01001_008",  # Male 20–24
  "B01001_009",  # Male 25–29
  "B01001_010",  # Male 30–34
  "B01001_011",  # Male 35–44
  "B01001_012",  # Male 45–54
  "B01001_013",  # Male 55–64
  "B01001_014",  # Male 65–74
  "B01001_015",  # Male 75–84
  "B01001_016",  # Male 85+
  "B01001_031",  # Female 18–19
  "B01001_032",  # Female 20–24
  "B01001_033",  # Female 25–29
  "B01001_034",  # Female 30–34
  "B01001_035",  # Female 35–44
  "B01001_036",  # Female 45–54
  "B01001_037",  # Female 55–64
  "B01001_038",  # Female 65–74
  "B01001_039",  # Female 75–84
  "B01001_040"   # Female 85+
)

# ===============================
# RACE (B02001)
# ===============================
race_vars <- c(
  "B02001_002",  # White
  "B02001_003",  # Black or African American
  "B02001_004",  # Native American
  "B02001_005",  # Asian
  "B02001_006",  # Pacific Islander
  "B02001_007",  # Other race
  "B02001_008"   # Two+ races
)

# ===============================
# ETHNICITY (B03003)
# ===============================
ethnicity_vars <- c(
  "B03003_003"  # Hispanic or Latino
)

# ===============================
# DISABILITY (B18101)
# ===============================
disability_vars <- c(
  "B18101_004",  # Hearing
  "B18101_006",  # Vision
  "B18101_008",  # Cognitive
  "B18101_010",  # Ambulatory
  "B18101_012",  # Self-care
  "B18101_014"   # Independent living
)

# ===============================
# LANGUAGE (B16004)
# ===============================
language_groups <- list(
  English  = c("B16004_002"),
  Spanish  = c("B16004_003", "B16004_004", "B16004_005", "B16004_006"),
  IndoEuro = c("B16004_007", "B16004_008", "B16004_009", "B16004_010"),
  Asian    = c("B16004_011", "B16004_012", "B16004_013", "B16004_014"),
  Other    = c("B16004_015", "B16004_016", "B16004_017", "B16004_018")
)

# ============================================
# MASTER FUNCTION 
# ============================================

pull_percent_total <- function(vars, label) {
  
  df <- get_acs(
    geography = "county",
    variables = vars,
    year = 2022,
    survey = "acs5"
  )

  wide <- df %>%
    select(GEOID, variable, estimate) %>%  
    pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate)

  wide %>% mutate(
    total = rowSums(across(all_of(vars)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>% select(GEOID, !!label := total)
}

# ============================================
# PULL TOTALS
# ============================================

age_totals        <- pull_percent_total(age_vars, "age_18plus")
race_totals       <- pull_percent_total(race_vars, "race_total")
ethnicity_totals  <- pull_percent_total(ethnicity_vars, "hispanic_total")
disability_totals <- pull_percent_total(disability_vars, "disability_total")

language_totals <- map2_df(language_groups, names(language_groups), pull_percent_total)

# ============================================
# COUNTY POPULATION TOTAL
# ============================================

county_total <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B01001_001", # Total population
  year = 2022,
  survey = "acs5"
) %>% select(GEOID, county_pop = estimate)

# ============================================
# MERGE & COMPUTE PERCENTAGES
# ============================================

final_demographics <- county_total %>%
  left_join(age_totals, by = "GEOID") %>%
  left_join(race_totals, by = "GEOID") %>%
  left_join(ethnicity_totals, by = "GEOID") %>%
  left_join(disability_totals, by = "GEOID") %>%
  left_join(language_totals, by = "GEOID") %>%
  mutate(
    pct_age_18plus = age_18plus / county_pop * 100,
    pct_hispanic   = hispanic_total / county_pop * 100,
    pct_disability   = disability_total / county_pop * 100
  )

# ============================================
# SAVE OUTPUT (OPTIONAL)
# ============================================

# write.csv(final_demographics, "county_demographics_percentages.csv", row.names = FALSE)
